notes: VIP Knoxville listings are sparse — often only a venue name and sometimes a start time.
Addresses, fees, dress codes and exact hours were enriched from organizer pages, prior-year editions, and known Knoxville venue addresses. Street addresses are included wherever the venue is known.
feeStatus/dressStatus: confirmed = published; typical = inferred from this event type/prior year; unknown = not found.
Attractiveness (1–10) = expected conventional attractiveness of women at the event, based on dress code, ticket price, venue, and typical Knoxville social-circuit demographics.
Ratio (1–10) = expected women:men. 10 = almost all women, 5 = even, 1 = almost all men.
Scene score = 0.55*attractiveness + 0.45*ratio. Heuristic, not a headcount.
Past events before 2026-09-08 were omitted. Duplicate VIP rows (Evening of Impact, Boots Bowties, Greek Fest weekend, Townsend weekend) were merged.

Expansion sources added 8 Sep 2026 per docs/recommended-expansion.md: New2Knox, SalsaKnox, WCR Knoxville, Junior League, Visit Knoxville/Inside of Knoxville pipe, Hampton House × HEX, Kendra Scott ColorBar. Bench named event: Appalachian Ballet Emerald Masquerade.
lululemon Kingston Pike had no future dated store events after 8 Sep 2026 (Global Run Day and Summer Series already passed) — not invented.
SalsaKnox is weekly; only the next five Fri/Sat nights are materialized so the dashboard is not 52 clones.
Visit Knoxville’s events page did not yield a parseable calendar; the filtered pipe used Inside of Knoxville’s 10-day planner + Downtown ArtWalk.
Kendra Scott ColorBar is a bookable standing product (no public fall 2026 ticket date). Listed as a date-range, not a fake one-off.
origin field names the calendar. VIP rows tagged origin=VIP Knoxville.
